title: Membrane-binding mechanism of the EEA1 FYVE domain revealed by multi-scale molecular dynamics simulations
authors: Andreas Haahr Larsen; Lilya Tata; Laura John; Mark S.P. Sansom
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多尺度MD模拟研究EEA1 FYVE结构域与含PI(3)P膜的结合机制，属于蛋白质-膜互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法（MD模拟）可部分借鉴。
abstract: Early Endosomal Antigen 1 (EEA1) is a key protein in endosomal trafficking and is implicated in both autoimmune and neurological diseases. The C-terminal FYVE domain of EEA1 binds endosomal membranes, which contain phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate (PI(3)P). Although it is known that FYVE binds PI(3)P specifically, it has not previously been described of how FYVE attaches and binds to endosomal membranes. In this study, we employed both coarse-grained (CG) and atomistic (AT) molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to determine how FYVE binds to PI(3)P-containing membranes. CG-MD showed that the dominant membrane binding mode resembles the crystal structure of EEA1 FYVE domain in complex with inositol-1,3-diphospate (PDB ID 1JOC). FYVE, which is a homodimer, binds the membrane via a hinge mechanism, where the C-terminus of one monomer first attaches to the membrane, followed by the C-terminus of the other monomer. The total binding energy is 70 kJ/mol, of which 50-60 kJ/mol stems from specific PI(3)P-interactions. By AT-MD, we could partition the binding mode into two types: (i) adhesion by electrostatic FYVE-PI(3)P interaction, and (ii) insertion of amphipathic loops. The AT simulations also demonstrated flexibility within the FYVE homodimer between the C-terminal heads and coiled-coil stem, allowing binding via a mechanism resembling that of a suction cup connected to a locally rigid stem via a flexible hinge.
abstract_zh: 早期内体抗原1（EEA1）是内体运输中的关键蛋白，与自身免疫性疾病和神经系统疾病均有关联。EEA1的C端FYVE结构域结合含有磷脂酰肌醇-3-磷酸（PI(3)P）的内体膜。尽管已知FYVE特异性结合PI(3)P，但此前尚未描述FYVE如何附着并结合内体膜。在本研究中，我们采用粗粒化（CG）和全原子（AT）分子动力学（MD）模拟来确定FYVE如何与含PI(3)P的膜结合。CG-MD显示，主要的膜结合模式类似于EEA1 FYVE结构域与肌醇-1,3-二磷酸复合物的晶体结构（PDB ID 1JOC）。FYVE作为同源二聚体，通过铰链机制结合膜，其中一单体的C端首先附着于膜，随后另一单体的C端附着。总结合能为70 kJ/mol，其中50-60 kJ/mol来源于特异性PI(3)P相互作用。通过AT-MD，我们将结合模式分为两种类型：（i）通过静电FYVE-PI(3)P相互作用的粘附，以及（ii）两亲性环的插入。AT模拟还展示了FYVE同源二聚体在C端头部与卷曲螺旋茎之间的柔韧性，允许通过一种类似于吸盘通过柔性铰链连接到局部刚性茎的机制进行结合。
